user.title: Watch a place
user.description: The address of a Vigie API instance and the place whose official weather warnings you want, and the earthquakes near it. The public instance and your home zone are suggested. This is not an official warning service: follow the warnings of your national authorities.

data_description.name: Names the device and its entities.
data_description.url: The public instance, {public}, is suggested; or the address of your own instance, for example {example} (the machine that runs the Vigie API, and its port).
data_description.location: The point whose warnings are read: a warning counts when its area contains it.

reconfigure.title: Change the instance or the place
reconfigure.description: The entities keep their identity; the entry is reloaded.

data_description.name: Names the device and its entities.
data_description.location: The point whose warnings are read.

error.cannot_connect: The instance did not answer. Check the address, the port and that the Vigie API is running.
error.invalid_response: The address answers, but not like a Vigie API (/v1/health).
error.invalid_url: This is not an http or https address.

abort.already_configured: This place is already watched on this instance.

data_description.scan_interval: Minutes between two reads of the instance (1 to 60). A push from the instance, when it offers one, reads sooner.
data_description.river_radius_km: How far from the place a river section still counts, in kilometres (France, Vigicrues; 1 to 50).
data_description.quake_radius_km: How far from the place an earthquake counts, in kilometres (10 to 3000). The earthquakes are a layer of their own (USGS, EMSC), not official warnings.
data_description.quake_min_magnitude: The smallest magnitude shown and announced (4.5 to 9). The sources the API reads list nothing below 4.5.
data_description.experimental_prealert: Off by default. A test of Vigie, being improved: levels computed by Vigie from the ECMWF forecast for the province of Turkey the place is in, with thresholds of its own. It is not an official warning and must not be taken for one: follow the warnings of the Turkish State Meteorological Service (MGM). Only an instance that runs the pre-alert answers it.
